calls.reason: A prospective clinical study found GPT-4 management plans harmful in 16% of bacteremia cases and called use without specialists hazardous; a second study found low concordance with consult answers.
Stack Overflow moderators banned ChatGPT answers on Dec 5, 2022, citing a high rate of incorrect but plausible answers across thousands of posts, consistent with regular false output.
The only evidence is a user study where GPT-4 matched users' intent categories about 90% of the time, which leans against the claim but does not show practical assistant adequacy either way.
GPT-4 released March 14, 2023; the DecodingTrust evaluation of June 20, 2023 reported previously unpublished GPT-4 stereotype-bias vulnerabilities about three months later.
The packet only confirms GPT-4's release and ChatGPT's prior popularity; no source compares public attention to the two launches.
Scaling studies show predictable gains and data-constrained diminishing returns, but none establishes a lasting ceiling below trustworthy general intelligence; the claim is open-ended.
